Write one site note per station, in the order given, using exactly this template for each station:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

## Bori Metropolis — Borehole Siting Notes (from VES layer models)

**Station:** Kogam-street
**Curve type:** HAA-type (file entry confirmed by model: 127 > 50.4 < 126 < 149 < 197 Ω·m)
**Aquifer depth:** 6.45 – 57.3 m (layers 3 and 4; best screen interval 30 – 57 m)
**Recommendation:** Best prospect in the area — drill to about 60 m and case off the conductive clayey layer 2 (0.8 – 6.45 m), screening the 126–149 Ω·m sands between 30 m and 57 m. If yield is low, deepen into layer 5 (197 Ω·m) below 57 m.

**Station:** Bori-police-station
**Curve type:** HA-type (file entry confirmed: 150 > 97.1 < 284 < 700 Ω·m)
**Aquifer depth:** 7.44 – 45 m (layer 3, 284 Ω·m)
**Recommendation:** Drill to ~50 m and screen 15 – 45 m in the layer-3 sand; seal off the clayey 97 Ω·m horizon (1.2 – 7.4 m) to protect water quality. The 700 Ω·m basal unit is likely dry/coarse and should not be relied on as the main target.

**Station:** Court-road
**Curve type:** AKH-type (16.8 < 73.3 < 701 > 51.6 < 99.8 Ω·m) — the "Q-type" on file does not match the model and should be corrected in the records
**Aquifer depth:** 12.9 – 62.9 m (layer 3); deep reserve target below 114 m (layer 5, 99.8 Ω·m)
**Recommendation:** Drill to ~70 m and screen the lower, saturated part of the 701 Ω·m sand/gravel (roughly 40 – 62 m), as the upper part may be above the water table. Avoid the 51.6 Ω·m clay (62.9 – 114 m) and keep the very conductive 16.8 Ω·m topsoil fully cased.

**Station:** Gokana-street
**Curve type:** HAA-type (file entry confirmed: 1420 > 859 < 987 < 2246 < 34337 Ω·m)
**Aquifer depth:** 2.93 – 17.4 m (layer 3, 987 Ω·m) — marginal, low confidence
**Recommendation:** Poor groundwater prospect: resistivities are very high throughout and the basal 34,337 Ω·m unit is effectively impermeable dry rock/laterite. Recommend re-siting toward Kogam-street or Bori-police-station rather than committing a production rig here; if a test hole is required, limit it to ~25 m.

**Station:** Kenpoly-convocation-arena
**Curve type:** KHK-type (1434 < 1879 > 318 < 3488 > 542 Ω·m) — the "A-type" on file does not match the model and should be corrected in the records
**Aquifer depth:** 7.92 – 25.9 m (layer 3, 318 Ω·m); secondary target below 50.2 m (layer 5, 542 Ω·m)
**Recommendation:** Drill to ~30 m and screen the 318 Ω·m layer from about 10 – 25 m, which is the only clearly saturated-looking unit in the profile. If that interval underperforms, deepen past the 3488 Ω·m hard layer into the 542 Ω·m basal unit below 50 m.

**Station:** Kor-road
**Curve type:** HK-type (file entry confirmed: 1916 > 1252 < 1658 > 581 Ω·m)
**Aquifer depth:** Below 111 m (layer 4, 581 Ω·m — base not resolved)
**Recommendation:** This is a deep-drilling site only: expect ~111 m of hard, resistive overburden before reaching the 581 Ω·m zone, so plan for a rig capable of 140 m with full casing through the dry section. Confirm budget and rig capacity before mobilising, or consider a shallower alternative site.

**Station:** Bank-road
**Curve type:** AA-type (file entry confirmed: 640 < 934 < 2594 < 4386 Ω·m)
**Aquifer depth:** None reliably identified; only marginal interval 5.21 – 13.8 m (934 Ω·m)
**Recommendation:** Do not drill a production borehole here — resistivity increases steadily with depth to 4386 Ω·m, indicating dry, compact material with no identifiable aquifer within the surveyed depth. Re-site the hole, preferably toward Kogam-street or Bori-police-station.

**Station:** Monokpo-street
**Curve type:** HAA-type (file entry confirmed: 1426 > 569 < 1241 < 1931 < 2994 Ω·m)
**Aquifer depth:** 3.2 – 26.4 m (layer 3, 1241 Ω·m) — marginal, low confidence
**Recommendation:** Weak prospect: the only conductive unit (569 Ω·m) is just 1 m thick and resistivity rises to 2994 Ω·m at depth. Treat any hole here as exploratory to ~30 m, and expect to re-site if the layer-3 interval is dry.

**General note for the crew:** Curve-type entries on file for Court-road and Kenpoly-convocation-arena are inconsistent with their layer models and have been corrected above; please flag these to the survey office. Record static water level and strike depths at every hole so the layer interpretations can be calibrated.
